content: # CoolAid's NoSignGUI ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loaders-Fabric%2fForge%2fNeoForge-red?style=for-the-badge) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Versions-1.20_|_1.21_|_26.1_|_26.2-red?style=for-the-badge) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Environments-Client-red?style=for-the-badge) ### 允许你开启或关闭告示牌文本界面！ - **当你需要大量使用空白告示牌进行建造或布置陷阱时，此功能尤为实用** - **默认按 `G` 键切换模组开关** - **灵感源自 [Masonion的NoSignGUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/nosigngui) 模组** - **兼容悬挂式告示牌，且完全在客户端运行** #### 如有任何问题或功能建议，请前往 [GitHub](https://github.com/CoolAid48/NoSignGUI/issues) 提交反馈 [](https://ko-fi.com/coolaid48) [](https://discord.gg/J2SGshKNah) [](https://www.twitch.tv/coolaid48)
